core_question: Does the project respond responsibly to real skin-health needs?
current_evidence: NUS interview themes; responsible reframing from generic whitening toward pigmentation-related needs; industry demand for quality/safety evidence
planned_metrics: Purity; byproducts; safety evidence; efficacy evidence; Round 2 acceptance
key_risk: Overclaiming health benefit without direct efficacy/safety evidence
current_readiness: Qualitative evidence available; experimental evidence incomplete

core_question: Can GALATEA lower resource/process burden per unit product?
current_evidence: Protocol identifies precursor, culture, water, ethyl acetate, methanol and recurring equipment operations
planned_metrics: Substrate consumed; biomass-normalized uptake; PMI; water intensity; solvent intensity; waste intensity; process energy
key_risk: Burden shifting to solvent, water, energy or GMO waste
current_readiness: Inventory framework ready; actual batch data incomplete

core_question: Can the improvement become a reliable and economically plausible manufacturing process?
current_evidence: Industry feedback emphasizes purity, cost, supply stability and a complete data package
planned_metrics: Productivity; purity; recovery; batch CV; cost/g; sensitivity; scale-up scenario
key_risk: Lab-scale benefit may not persist at scale; engineering complexity
current_readiness: Stakeholder requirements available; quantitative process data incomplete
